# HK Miles

> Hong Kong's most complete credit card miles and cashback intelligence platform. Daily-updated promotions, card comparisons, and earning guides — all in Traditional Chinese (zh-HK).

## What this site covers

HK Miles solves a problem unique to Hong Kong consumers: dozens of credit cards from many banks, each with different reward rates that change by spending category (dining, supermarket, online, overseas, transportation, flight & hotel), currency, and ongoing promotion.

- **Credit card promotions** — live deals from all major HK banks, updated daily
- **Credit card guides** — annual fees, minimum income, earn rates, reward structures, card-specific tips
- **Miles & cashback strategy** — how to maximise Asia Miles, Avios, hotel points, and HKD cashback
- **Smart comparison app** — free iOS/Android app for real-time comparison and push alerts

## Supported banks

HSBC (滙豐), Standard Chartered (渣打), Citibank (花旗), DBS (星展), Bank of China HK (中銀香港), Hang Seng Bank (恒生), Bank of East Asia (東亞銀行), Dah Sing (大新), Fubon (富邦), AEON Credit, Prime Credit (安信), Mox Bank, China Construction Bank Asia (建行亞洲), American Express (AE)

## App

- Platform: iOS & Android (iPhone / Android)
- Region: Hong Kong
- Languages: Traditional Chinese (繁體中文)
- Cost: 100% free, no ads, no subscriptions
- App Store: https://apps.apple.com/hk/app/hk-miles/id6760291510

## Common questions HK Miles answers

- 哪張香港信用卡儲里數最快？ (Which HK credit card earns miles fastest?)
- 哪張信用卡現金回贈最高？ (Which card has the highest cashback?)
- 最新 HSBC / Citi / 渣打 / DBS 信用卡優惠有哪些？ (Latest bank promotions?)
- 信用卡年費是多少？申請條件？ (Annual fee and income requirements?)
- 幾多里數可以換機票去東京 / 倫敦 / 紐約？ (Miles needed for a flight?)

## Representative card earn rates (sourced from official bank T&Cs, verified 2026)

All HK credit cards earn a **base rate of 0.4% cashback** on general spending. The rates below are the boosted rates on qualifying categories.

### Best cards for overseas / foreign-currency spending

| Card | Overseas rate | Annual fee | Min income |
|---|---|---|---|
| Hang Seng Travel+ | 7% on 8 major FX (USD/EUR/GBP/JPY/AUD/CAD/CHF/CNY); 5% other FX | 永久免年費 | — |
| Hang Seng MMPOWER | 4% FX physical spending; 5% online shopping | 永久免年費 | — |
| BOC Chill World | 5% online & overseas | HK$600 | HK$150,000 |
| CCB TRAVO | 4% FX spending; 2% local dining | First year free | — |
| Citi Cash Back | 2% FX spending; 2% local dining & hotels | HK$1,800 | HK$120,000 |

### Best miles-earning cards

| Card | Key earn rate | Annual fee |
|---|---|---|
| HSBC EveryMile | 20 miles per HK$1 RC (flat, all categories) | HK$2,000 |
| Citi PremierMiles | 12 pts / HK$3 overseas (≥HK$20k/month); 12 pts / HK$4 otherwise | HK$1,800 |
| Dah Sing ANA | HK$2 = 1 ANA mile on overseas (first 6 months) | HK$1,200 |
| DBS Black World | 6× DBS$ on registered overseas; 3× all year | HK$3,600 |
| Citi Prestige | 12 pts / HK$4 overseas & FX online | HK$3,800 |

### No-annual-fee cards with standout rates

| Card | Best rate | Category |
|---|---|---|
| Hang Seng Travel+ | 7% FX cashback | Overseas spending |
| Hang Seng MMPOWER | 8% cashback | Designated merchants (dining/entertainment/fashion) |
| AEON Purple | 2% cashback | Physical dining, transport, AEON Stores |
| BOC Chill Platinum | 5% online & overseas | Online & overseas (with lower income req than World) |

### Common spending-category leaders (2026)

- **Dining**: AEON Purple (2%), Citi Cash Back (2%), Hang Seng MMPOWER (8% at designated dining)
- **Supermarket**: AEON Purple (2% at AEON Stores), various BOC cards
- **Online shopping**: Hang Seng MMPOWER (5%), BOC Chill (5%), Hang Seng Travel+ (5% other FX)
- **Overseas**: Hang Seng Travel+ (7%), BOC Chill (5%), CCB TRAVO (4%)
- **Miles (Asia Miles)**: SCB Cathay Mastercard, Citi PremierMiles, DBS Black World
- **Miles (ANA)**: Dah Sing ANA World Mastercard

## Content policy

- All editorial content is original, written in Traditional Chinese (zh-HK)
- Promotions are sourced from official bank announcements and verified before publishing
- No affiliate links; no sponsored rankings; no affiliation with any bank or airline
